title: LLM refinement rejected, reverted to deterministic output
detail: The model's response for this file failed a basic sanity/YAML check and was discarded; the deterministic transform/remediate output was kept.
remediation: Optionally re-run with LLM_FORCE_REFRESH=true, or inspect the cached prompt/response under LLM_CACHE_DIR.

title: Route TLS termination requires a secretName
detail: The source Route specified TLS. The emitted Ingress references .Values.route.tlsSecretName, which is not yet defined.
remediation: Provision/import the TLS secret on AKS and set route.tlsSecretName in the environment's values file.

title: Server-side validation skipped (offline mode)
detail: helm --dry-run=server and kubectl auth can-i require cluster access.
remediation: Re-run with --mode connected once credentials are available.
